courses.summary: 以智利沙漠大型銅礦為案例，連結礦石變異、選礦與遠距供水的系統邊界。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A Chilean desert copper case linking ore variability, concentration and the boundary of long-distance water supply. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
